- Net revenue for women's products reached $398,405.73 in Q3 2026, marking a 26.2% increase compared to Q2 2026 ($315,617.28) and an 85.3% surge over Q3 2025 ($214,959.77).

- To sustain momentum into Q4, merchandising and marketing teams need to capitalize on top-performing categories (Intimates, Outerwear & Coats, Jeans) while addressing high-return categories like Skirts and Blazers.

## Key findings
- **Revenue and Order Growth**: Q3 2026 net revenue hit $398,405.73 across 5,123 orders (up from 4,000 orders in Q2 2026 and 2,706 in Q3 2025). 
- **Customer Acquisition**: New customers accounted for 64.6% of Q3 revenue ($261,963.98 from 3,033 new buyers), while returning customers contributed $135,964.84 from 1,660 buyers.

- **Traffic Channels**: Search remained the dominant acquisition channel, generating $278,868.16 (70.0% of total net revenue), followed by Organic ($56,776.68) and Facebook ($27,856.54).

# Q3 2026 Performance Review & Q4 Action Plan

## Executive summary
- Net revenue for women's products reached $398,405.73 in Q3 2026, marking a 26.2% increase compared to Q2 2026 ($315,617.28) and an 85.3% surge over Q3 2025 ($214,959.77).
- Growth was driven primarily by a 28.1% expansion in active customers (4,693 buyers vs. 3,782 in Q2), fueled by strong acquisition through Search traffic.
- To sustain momentum into Q4, merchandising and marketing teams need to capitalize on top-performing categories (Intimates, Outerwear & Coats, Jeans) while addressing high-return categories like Skirts and Blazers.

## Key findings
- **Revenue and Order Growth**: Q3 2026 net revenue hit $398,405.73 across 5,123 orders (up from 4,000 orders in Q2 2026 and 2,706 in Q3 2025). 
- **Customer Acquisition**: New customers accounted for 64.6% of Q3 revenue ($261,963.98 from 3,033 new buyers), while returning customers contributed $135,964.84 from 1,660 buyers.
- **Top Categories**: Intimates ($39,881.11), Outerwear & Coats ($37,217.15), and Jeans ($35,035.23) led Q3 sales, all more than doubling compared to Q3 2025.
- **Return Rates**: Skirts (12.8%), Blazers & Jackets (12.1%), and Leggings (12.0%) experienced the highest item return rates in Q3.
- **Traffic Channels**: Search remained the dominant acquisition channel, generating $278,868.16 (70.0% of total net revenue), followed by Organic ($56,776.68) and Facebook ($27,856.54).

## Why it happened
- **Customer Expansion**: The quarter-over-quarter revenue jump was propelled by a 24.1% increase in active shoppers (4,693 vs. 3,782 in Q2), while average order value remained stable at $77.77 (compared to $78.90 in Q2).
- **Seasonal Shift**: As temperatures cooled toward the end of Q3, demand for Outerwear & Coats surged to $37,217.15 (up 76.4% year-over-year from $21,102.49 in Q3 2025).
- **Acquisition Efficiency**: Search engine marketing continued to capture high-intent shoppers efficiently, bringing in 3,288 buying customers.

## Action items
| Action | Owner (Team) | Priority | Expected impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Expand inventory depth and feature promotions for high-demand Q4 seasonal categories (Outerwear & Coats, Sweaters) | Merchandising | High | Capture peak winter demand and increase average order value |
| Audit product descriptions, sizing charts, and fabric details for Skirts and Blazers & Jackets | Merchandising / Product | Medium | Reduce return rates from current highs above 12.0% |
| Scale paid search campaigns and optimize ad spend allocation for top-performing acquisition segments | Marketing | High | Maintain customer acquisition velocity heading into the holiday season |
| Implement targeted email retention campaigns for the 3,033 new customers acquired in Q3 | CRM / Marketing | Medium | Increase repeat-purchase rate and improve customer lifetime value |

## Method and caveats
- **Data Scope**: Covers women's department products (`department = 'Women'`) sold via `order_items` and joined with `products` and `users`.
- **Definitions**: Net revenue is the sum of `sale_price` for items whose status is not 'Cancelled' or 'Returned'. New customers are defined as those whose first recorded purchase fell within Q3 2026 (2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30).
- **Caveats**: Marketing spend and website session data are not available in the platform, so channel efficiency is evaluated strictly on net revenue and buyer counts.
